name: CodePie
description: A full-stack competitive-programming platform built for CHARUSAT, powering contests, topic-based practice problems, solo/team modes, and real-time leaderboards - now used university-wide for DBMS, DSA, DAA, and CP assessments. SQL problems run in isolated, per-submission Docker containers with dynamically created schemas, and the backend has been stress-tested to reliably handle 1,000+ concurrent submissions.
features: Create and schedule secure DSA contests
Real-time student code evaluation using Judge0
Anti-cheating via session monitoring and environment isolation
Scalable backend tested with 200+ concurrent students
Role-based access for faculty and students
